headline.line: This study analyzes mobility inequalities in Casablanca and Rabat, Morocco, using household travel survey data covering more than 36,000 individuals.

synthesis.paragraph: Today's issue features 3 papers with the "interview" tag, compared to its 25-day average of 0.8 per day, and includes 2 papers from the Universidade de São Paulo. The paper "Assessing urban mobility behaviors and inequalities in Morocco’s major cities through socio-economic indicators: Cases of Casablanca and Rabat" shares 4 references with the 2026-06-15 paper "A directional latent demand index for city links: from mobility traces to service gaps", and also shares 4 references with the 2026-06-16 paper "First–last mile gaps and transport-related social exclusion: A spatial analysis of Jakarta's feeder network". Additionally, "Machine learning downscaling of satellite derived land surface temperature in the historic urban heritage area of São João del-Rei Brazil" shares 4 references with the 2026-06-27 paper "A causal deep learning framework for simulating the thermal impact of urban land use changes". Over the last 30 days, Hong Kong Polytechnic University has appeared on 24 papers, Tsinghua University on 19 papers, University of Hong Kong on 18 papers, and Peking University on 17 papers.
